קָמָי לֵב‎ probably late Atbash (compare שֵׁשַׁךְ‎) for p. 1058 כשׂדים‎ the orginal reading (ᵐ5‎) Jer 51:1.

קוּם‎628 verb arise, stand up, stand; — (Late Hebrew in derived species and derivatives; Phoenician Hiph`il Participle and מקם‎ place; Arabic stand, rise, Ethiopic stand, stop; Sabean מקם‎, place, HomChrest. 127; Aramaic קוּם‎, = Biblical Hebrew, so Old Aramaic Nabataean קום‎; Palmyrene Aph`el אקים‎ erect statue; compare probably Assyrian kumu (k = כ‎), place, dwelling, kum, kêmu, in place of, and perhaps kaiamânu, enduring, constant (see כִּיּוּן‎); Thes compare also Samaritan image unavailable, live, compare especially ᵑ7‎ Pa`el); —

Qal460 Perfect3masculine singular קָם‎ 1Sam 17:48 +, וְקָאם‎ consecutive Hosea 10:14 (Ges§ 72p); 2 masculine singular קַמְתָּ‎ 2Sam 12:21, etc.; Imperfect3masculine singular יָקוּם‎ Exod 21:19, jussive יָקֻם‎ Gen 27:31, (לָ֑ךְׅ וְיָ֫קָם‎ Job 22:28 (Ges§ 109h Dr§ 152 (3)); וַיָּ֫קָם‎ Gen 4:8 +, etc.; Imperative masculine singular קוּם‎ 13:17 +, feminine plural קֹמְנָה‎ Isa 32:9, etc.; Infinitive absolute קוֺם‎ Jer 44:29; construct קָוּם‎ Amos 5:2 +, etc.; Participle> feminine singular קָמָה‎ Micah 7:6; masculine plural קָמִים‎ 2Sam 18:31 +, הַקּוֺמִים‎ 2Kin 16:17 (Ges§ 72p), etc.; —

1 arise: מִתַּחְתָּיו‎ Exod 10:23 (E). Specifically:

a. after lying down (sleep, sickness, mourning, etc.), 1Sam 3:6, 8; 2Sam 12:21; Exod 21:19; Gen 19:33, 35; 31:17; Ruth 3:14; Eccl 12:4 50t.; from lying dead, עַלרַֿגְלָיו קַיָּקָם‎ 2Kin 13:21, compare Job 14:12; Isa 26:14, 19; Psa 88:11; after falling Amos 5:2; 8:14; Jer 8:4; 25:27 4t. (chiefly figurative); after being smitten, wounded, etc. Psa 18:39 || 2Sam 22:39; Isa 27:9 (of Asherim, etc.), 43:17 4t.; from sitting, reclining, especially at meals Gen 25:34; 1Sam 1:9; 20:34 (הַשֻּׁלְחָן מֵעִם‎; 20:25 see קָדַם‎), Est 7:7 ( +אֶל‎ in construction Praegn.), but also Judg 3:20 (מֵעַל‎), 2Sam 2:14 (twice in verse); 2:15, Jonah 3:6 (מִכִּסְאוֺ‎), + 11 t., + (arise = stand up, in respect), Gen 19:1 ( +לִקְתָאתָם‎), 31:35 (מִמָּנֶיךָ‎), Lev 19:32 (מִמְּנֵי‎), Isa 49:7; Job 29:8; + וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ‎ 2Kin 2:19, compare Gen 23:7; Exod 33:10; 1Sam 20:41; 25:41; — (see also

e); from kneeling (מִן‎ + מִלִּפְנֵי‎ location) 1Kin 8:54, from obeisance 1 Samuel 24:42; Est 8:4; from bending over (עַל‎) dead Gen 23:3 (P).

b. out of (מִן‎) a condition, state, Ezra 9:5.

c. of bear rising עַל‎ person, 1Sam 17:35.

d. arise (+ stand) Exod 33:8; Psa 20:9 (figurative of success, prosperity), Job 24:22 (id.), +; of sheaf Gen 37:7; of waters Josh 3:16 (נֵדאֶֿתָד‎).

e. construction Praegn. arise (and stand) for a purpose Num 11:32 (E); over, עַל‎ person, 2Sam 12:17.

f. arise as preliminary to formal speech Judg 20:8; Micah 6:1; Jer 1:17; 1Chr 28:2 (עַלרַֿגְלָיו‎), Prov 31:28; Job 30:28 5t.; to testify (against) Deut 19:15-16, (both ב‎ person), Psa 27:12; 35:11, compare also בִּי וַיָּקָם‎ Job 16:8 (of כַּחַשׁ‎ q. v.; Bu כַּעַשׂ‎); to vindicate 19:25 (עַלעַֿפָר‎); to read aloud Neh 9:3 (עַלעָֿמְדָם‎); to bless people 2Chr 30:27 (priests).

g. to listen to God's word Num 23:18; Isa 32:9; to praise God 2Chr 20:19; Neh 9:4-5,.

h. of noise, tumult Hosea 10:14; of light Job 25:3 (עַל‎ person).

2 arise, in hostile sense (optative with idea of suddenness); with עַל‎ person Deut 19:11 (out of ambush), 22:26; Judg 9:18; 20:5; Psa 27:3 (of war), Obadiah (לַמִּלְחָמָה‎), + 11 t., + Job 30:12 (according to Bu, reading עָלַי‎ for עִַליָֿמִין‎), + (of ׳י‎) Amos 7:9 (ב‎ instrumental), Isa 14:22; 31:2; with אֶל‎ person Gen 4:8; 1Sam 22:13; 24:8 (Gi v.24:7); with ב‎ person Micah 7:6; Psa 27:12 (false witness), Micah 7:6; with עַם‎ person Psa 94:16 (|| יִתְיַצֵּב‎); see especially participle with suffix = those rising up against me (thee, etc.) Exod 15:7; 32:25; Deut 33:11 8t. + Psa 109:28 (read ᵑ9 ᵐ5 יֵבשׁוּ קָמַי‎ Bae We Du, compare Hup Dr); with מִן‎ from, out of Josh 8:7, 19; Judg 9:35, 43; 20:33; = revolt Num 16:2 (לִפְנֵי‎ person), 2Kin 12:21; 2Chr 13:6, compare Hab 2:7.

3 arise, absolute, = become powerful Prov 28:12, 28.

4 arise = come on the scene, appear, of leader, prophet, king Judg 5:7 (twice in verse); 10:1, 3; Deut 13:2; 34:10; Exod 1:8; 2Kin 23:25; of years of famine Gen 41:30; with אַחֲרֵי‎ person Deut 29:21; Judg 2:10; 1Kin 3:12; with תַּחַת‎, in palce of, 8:20 2Chr 6:10; Num 32:14; with עַלמַֿמְלֶכֶת‎2Chr 21:4; with מִן‎ Num 24:17 (sceptre out of Israel); of calamity, Nahum 1:9; Prov 24:22; חָ֑לֶד יָקוּם מִצָּהֳרַיִם‎ Job 11:17 i.e. to shine upon thee.

5 arise for, i.e. to become, with ל‎ of thing; לְעַד קוּמִי בְּיוֺם‎ Zeph 3:8 (read לְעֵד‎, for a witness, ᵑ6 ᵐ5‎ We Now GASm compare Da); לְמַטֵּהרֶֿשַׁע קָם הֶחָמָס‎ Ezek 7:11 (but dubious; Co Berthol Krae קָמֵל‎).

6. a. arse for action, especially of ׳י‎ arising [from his throne], + infinitive Isa 2:19, 21; for judgement Psa 76:10 (לַמִּשְׁמָּט‎), Job 31:14; often Imperative Num 10:35; Jer 2:27; Psa 3:8 8t. Psalms + 2Chr 6:41 (with לְנוּחֶ֑ךָ‎), Psa 132:8 (with לִמְנוּחָתֶ֑ךָ‎); Imperfect Isa 28:21 4t.; Imperative also of men, arise ! up ! i.e. act ! Judg 4:14; Ezra 10:4, of idols Jer 2:28; Imperfect of the tongue (personified) Isa 54:17 (לַמִּשְׁמָּט אִתָּךְ‎).

b. arise (out of inaction), introducing some specific deed Gen 21:18; Exod 32:1; Judg 5:12; 8:20-21, Jer 49:14 (לַמִּלְחָמָה‎), Obadiah (וְנָקוּמָה קוּמוּ לַמִּלְחָמָה עָלֶיחָ‎), + 37 t.

c. especially arise = start, make a move, to go somewhere, Gen 13:17; 19:14-15, 1Sam 9:3; Jonah 1:3 (in flight), 3:3 110t.

7 stand: especially figurative

a. = maintain oneself Josh 7:12-13, (J E; לִפְנֵי‎ person), Amos 7:2, 5; Nahum 1:6; Lam 1:14; Psa 1:5; 24:3; Job 41:18 (of sword), of courage (רוּח‎) Josh 2:11 (D; בְּאִישׁ‎, + לִפְנֵי‎ person).

b. = be established, confirmed, of kingdom 1Sam 24:21 (בְּיָָֽדְךָ‎; Gi v.24:20); of purchase Lev 27:19, with ל‎ person be assured to 25:30; Gen 23:17, 20 (all P).

c. stand, endure 1Sam 13:14; Job 8:15 (|| עָמַד‎), 15:29.

d. = be fixed, of price, Lev 27:14, 17.

e. = be valid, of vows, Num 30:5 (twice in verse) + 6 t. Numbers 30 + 30:10 (with עַל‎ person; all P).

f. = be proven Deut 19:15.

g. = be fulfilled Jer 44:29 (imperfect + infinitive absolute; עַל‎ person), Job 22:28 (ל‎ person); of ׳י‎s purpose Jer 51:29 (עַל‎ person), Isa 14:24; Prov 19:21, compare Jer 44:28; Isa 40:8; 46:10; of human plans, succeed 7:7; 8:10; 28:18; Prov 15:22.

h. persist, יָקוּם עַלנְֿדִיבוֺת‎ Isa 32:8 literally on noble things doth he take his stand.

i. אָחִיו עַלאשֵׁם יָקוּם‎ Deut 25:6 he shall stand upon the name of his dead brother, represent him.

j. of eyes, = be set, fixed, without vision 1Sam 4:15; 1Kin 14:4 (עַיִן‎ 1i).

Pi`el Perfect3masculine singular קִיַּם‎ Est 9:31-32, 3plural קִיְּמוּ‎ 9:27; 9:31; Imperfect1singular וָאֲקַיֵּמָ֑ה‎ Psa 119:106; Imperative masculine singular suffix קַיְּמֵנִי‎ 119:28; Infinitive construct לְקַיֵּם‎ Ezek 13:6 +; — late (Aramaic):

1 fulful, Ezek 13:6; Psa 119:106.

2. a. confirm, ratify, Ruth 4:7.

b. confirm, establish, of ׳י‎ Psa 119:28 (with suffix accusative).

c. impose, an obligation, עַל‎ person Est 9:21, 31 b, עַל‎ reflexive 9:27; 9:31 c; with acc of thing 9:29; 9:31 a.; 9:32.

Po`l. raise up: Imperfect2masculine singular תְּקוֺמֵם‎ Isa 58:2; 1singular אֲקוֺמֵם‎ 44:26; 3masculine plural יְקוֺמֵ֑מוּ‎ 61:4 (all of rebuilding); — יְקוֺמֵם‎ Micah 2:8, read תָּקוּמוּ‎ We Now, or קָמִים‎ GASm Buhl.

Hithpolel raise oneself, = rise up: Participle feminine singular מִתְקוֺמָמָה‎ Job 20:27 (לְ‎ person against); masculine singular suffix מְ֑מִי‎ 27:7 one rising up against me (|| אֹיְבִי‎); plural absolute מְ֑מִים‎ Psa 17:7; suffix מְ֑מַי‎ 59:2; see also 139:21, reading וּבְמִתְקוֺמְמֶיךָ‎ (for ׳וּבִתְק ᵑ0‎; || מְשַׂנְאֶיךָ‎); see also קוּט‎.

Hiph`il146 Perfect3masculine singular הֵקִים‎ Josh 4:9 +; 2 masculine singular וַהֲקֵמֹתָ֫‎ Exod 26:30; Deut 27:2; 1singular הֲקִימֹתִי‎ 1Sam 15:13, הֲקִמֹתִי‎ Gen 9:17 +, etc.; Imperfect3masculine singular יָקִים‎ Deut 18:15 +; jussive יָקֵם‎ 1Sam 1:23 +; וַיָּ֫קֶם‎ Judg 2:16 +; 2 feminine plural תָּקִ֫ימְנָה‎ Jer 44:25, etc.; Imperative masculine singular הָקֵם‎ 2Sam 7:25 +, etc.; Infinitive absolute הָקֵים‎ Jer 44:25, הָקֵם‎ Deut 22:4; Judg 7:19; construct הָקִים‎ 2Sam 3:10 +, etc.; Participle מֵקִים‎ Amos 6:14 +, etc.; —

1 cause to arise, raise:

a. prostrate (accusative of person or thing) 2Sam 12:17 (מִןהָֿאָרֶץ‎), Deut 22:4 (עִמּוֺ תָּקִים הָקֵם‎), Psa 41:11; Eccl 4:10 (twice in verse); figurative Amos 5:2; 9:11 (twice in verse); Hosea 6:2; Isa 49:8; 1Sam 2:8 = Psa 113:7 (|| הֵרִים‎), Job 4:4; Jer 50:32.

b. from throne (מִן‎) Isa 14:9.

c. lift up shield (צִנָּה‎) against (עַל‎) Ezek 26:8.

d. figurative raise (to dignity, power) Isa 49:6.

2

a. raise, set up, stones Josh 4:9 (J E; בְּתוֺךְ‎ local), 4:20 (J E; ב‎ location), 24:26 (E; תַּחַת שָׁם,‎ location), Deut 27:2; pillars 1Kin 7:21 (3 t. in verse) || 2Chr 3:17; Exod 40:18 (P); מֶּסֶל מַצֵּבָה,‎ Judg 18:30 (ל‎ reflexive), Lev 26:1; Deut 16:22; throne, figurative, 2Sam 3:10, king Deut 28:36 (both with עַל‎ over.

b. erect, build: Isa 23:13; Exod 26:30; heap of stones over (עַל‎) Josh 7:26; 8:29; altar 2Sam 24:18 (׳לי‎) || 1Chr 21:18 (id.), 1Kin 16:32 (לבעל‎), 2Kin 21:8 (id.) = 2Chr 33:3 (לבעלים‎); curtains Jer 10:20 (of Judah's tent, in figure); tabernacle, etc., Exod 40:2, 18, 33 4t. Numbers; erect against (עַל‎) Isa 29:3.

c. figurative of setting up law Psa 78:5 (עֵדוּת‎; || שִׂים‎).

3 raise up = bring on the scene: with accusative, sons in place of (תַּחַת‎) fathers Josh 5:7, אַחֲרֵי‎ 2Sam 7:12 = 1Chr 17:11; 1Kin 15:4; raise up לְאָחִיךָ זֶרַע‎ Gen 38:8 (J); judges Judg 2:16, 18 (לָהֶם‎), compare 3:9, 15; (both ל‎ person); king Jer 30:9, צַדִּיק צֶמַח‎ 23:5, prophet 29:15; Deut 18:15, 18, priest 1Sam 2:35 (all ל‎ person); shepherds, etc. Micah 5:5 (עַל‎ against), Zech 11:16; שֵׁם לְאָחִיו לְהָקִים‎ Deut 25:7; plant of name Ezek 34:29 (ל‎ person); evil (רָעָה‎) 2Sam 12:11 (עַל‎ against).

4. a. raise up = rouse, stir up (lion, in figure) Gen 49:9 (poem) = Num 24:9 (JE).

b. instigate, with accusative of person +עַל‎ against Amos 6:14; 1Sam 22:8; +ל‎ person 1Kin 11:14, 23; with acc alone Hab 1:6.

5 raise up = constitute, לְעָם הָקִיםאֹֿתְךָל֗֗֗וֺ‎ Deut 29:12; compare 28:9; Job 16:12; לִנְבִיאִים מִבְּנֵיכֶם וָּאָקִים‎ Amos 2:11; לִדְמָמָה סְעָרָה יָקֵם‎ Psa 107:29 (compare Qal 5).

6 cause to stand:

a. set, station, sentinels Judg 7:19 (הֵקִים הָקֵם‎), Jer 51:12, compare 6:17 (עַל‎ person), 23:4; Ezek 34:23; set feet on (עַל‎) rock Psa 40:3.

b. cause to hold one's ground Psa 89:44 (בַּמִּלְחָמָה‎).

c. establish throne 2Chr 7:18, כָּלאַֿפְסֵיאָֿ֑רֶץ‎ Prov 30:4.

d. establish (make, ratify) covenant, of ׳י‎, with אֶת‎ (preposition) person Gen 6:18; 9:9, 11; 17:19, 21; Exod 6:4 (all P), Ezek 16:62; with בֵּיןבֵּ֗֗֗ין‎ Gen 9:17; 17:7 (both P); with ל‎ person Ezek 16:60.

e. = make binding, a vow Num 30:14; 30:15 (twice in verse).

f. = carry out, give effect to (DrSm. 1, 23), oath, covenant, vow, word, plan, command, of man 1Sam 15:11, 13 6t.; of ׳י‎ Gen 26:3; Lev 26:9; 1Sam 1:23; 1Kin 6:12; Deut 8:18; Jer 23:20 18t.

g. עַלנַֿחֲלָתוֺ שֵׁםהַֿמֵּת לְהָקִים‎ Ruth 4:5, 10 to cause the dead man's name to stand upon his inheritance (compare Qal 7 i).

Hoph`al Perfect3masculine singular הֻ֫קַםעָ֑ל‎ 2Sam 23:1 be raised up (on הֻ֫קַּם‎ van d. H., see Dr); הוּקַם‎ be set up Exod 40:17 (of tabernacle); פ אֶתדִּֿבְרֵי ׳הוּקַם‎ Jer 35:14 be held upright (Ges§ 121a), i.e. observed, obeyed.

[תְּקוֺמֵם‎], וּבִתְקוֺמְמֶיךָ‎ Psa 139:21, see v, Hithpolel

מָקֹם מָקוֺם,‎ (Exod 29:31, etc.)399

noun masculineGen 19:13 (but see below), standing-place, place; — absolute ׳מ‎ Exod 21:13 +; construct מְקוֺם‎ Gen 12:6 + (often before אֲשֶׁר‎ 39:20 +); suffix מְקוֺמוֺ‎ 1Sam 3:2 +, מְקֹמוֺ‎ Gen 18:33 +, etc.; plural usually מְקֹמוֺת‎ Judg 19:13 +, מְקוֺמוֺת‎ 1Sam 7:16; Jer 29:14, מֹ֑ת‎ 2Sam 17:9 2t.; suffix מְקוֺמֹתֵיכֶם‎ Amos 4:6, etc. [apparently feminine (not Gen 18:24, where עִיר‎ is in mind, but) Job 20:9 (emendation see Commentaries), and Manuscripts (either Kt of Qr) Judg 19:13; 2Sam 17:9, 12; mostly explained away by AlbrZAW xvi (1896), 53]; —

1. a. standing-place Exod 3:5 (E), Josh 5:15; Exod 33:21; Num 23:13, 27 (all J E), Gen 19:27 (J), Josh 3:3 (D), of מַצֵּבוֺת‎, etc., 2Kin 23:14, of ark (place where it is set, stands) 1Kin 8:7 2Chr 5:8, earth Isa 13:13; Job 9:6, rock 14:18; 18:4; compare 38:12, 19.

b. station, where soldiers are placed Josh 8:19 (JE), Judg 20:33 (twice in verse); post in battle 2Sam 11:16.

c. post, office 1Kin 20:24; Eccl 10:4.

2. a. place where a thing belongs Gen 29:3 (J), Josh 4:18 (JE), 1Sam 5:3; Isa 46:7; Job 6:17; 37:1 (of the heart), Eccl 1:5; especially of ark 1Sam 5:11 9t.; of person = destination Judg 11:19.

b. especially (1) place of human abode Gen 13:14; 20:13; Judg 7:7; 1Sam 2:20 42t., +אָהֳלֵךְ מְקוֺם‎ Isa 54:2. (2) of ׳י‎s abode Hosea 5:15, in heaven Micah 1:3; Isa 26:21; 1Kin 8:30 2Chr 6:21. (3) lair of lion (figurative) Jer 4:7.

3 place =

a. city Gen 18:24, 26; 20:11; Deut 21:19 (|| עִיר‎) 2Kin 18:25 39t. (1Sam 7:16 ᵐ5 הַמִּקְדָּשִׁים‎, compare We HPS).

b. of land: Canaan Exod 23:20; 1Sam 12:8; Jer 16:2-3,(|| אֶרֶץ‎) + 17 t. (12 t. Jeremiah); Philistia 1Sam 14:46; Egypt Jer 44:29; appositive מְדִינָה‎ Est 4:3, = מְדִינָה‎ + עִיר‎ 8:17.

c. plot, parcel, of ground Isa 7:23; הַגֹּרֶן מְקוֺם‎ 1Chr 21:22, compare 21:25; 2Chr 3:1.

קשה.def:
H7186. qasheh

קָשֶׁה‎ adjective hard, severe; — absolute ׳ק‎ Exod 18:26 +; construct 32:9 +; feminine singular קָשָׁה‎ Deut 26:6 +; construct קְשַׁת‎ 1Sam 1:15; masculine plural קָשִׁים‎ 2Sam 3:39; construct קְשֵׁי‎ Ezek 2:4; 3:7; feminine plural קָשׁוֺת‎ Gen 42:7, 30; —

1 hard, difficult, of a legal question (דָּבָר‎) Exod 18:26 (E).

2. a. severe, of battle 2Sam 2:17, wind Isa 27:8, servitude (עֲבֹדָה‎) 1Kin 12:4 2Chr 10:4; Deut 26:6; Isa 14:3; Exod 1:14; 6:9 (both P); as n.collective קָשָׁה עַמְּךָ הִרְאִיתָ‎ Psa 60:5 thou hast made thy people see severe things; יוֺם קְשֵׁה‎ Job 30:25 i.e. one whose time (life) is hard, so 1Sam 1:15 (reading יוֺם קְשַׁת‎ for ᵐ5 ׳ק, רוּחַ‎ Th We Dr and others); severe, rough, of lord (אֲדֹנִים‎) Isa 19:4, compare 2Sam 3:39 (with מִן‎ compare [מִמֶּנּוּ‎? see HPS]); עַלֿ וְקָשָׁה הָלוֺח‎ Judg 4:24 the hand of the sons of Israel went on being more and more severe upon Jabin; fierce, relentless, of ׳י‎'s sword Isa 27:1 (in figurative); rough, rude 1Sam 25:3; severe things, of language Gen 42:7, 30 (E; with דִּדֶּר‎), 1Sam 20:10; 1Kin 12:13 2Chr 10:13 (all with עָנָה‎); קָשָׁה אֵלַיִח שָׁלוּחַ וְאָנֹכִי‎ 1Kin 14:6 I am commissioned with a severe (message) unto thee (Ges§ 121d. N.2 DaSynt. §§ 75 (d), 80); קָשָׁה חָזוּת‎ Isa 21:2.

b. fierce, intense, vehement, of קִנְאָה‎ Song 8:6 (|| עַזָּה‎; compare Gen 49:9).

3 עַםקְֿשֵׁהעֹֿרֶף‎ a people stiff of neck, stubborn, Exod 32:9; 33:3, 5; 34:9 (all J E), Deut 9:6, 13; הַקָּשֶׁה עָרְמְּךָ‎ 31:27; compare הַקָּשָׁה דַּרְכָּם‎ Judg 2:19; פָנִים קְשֵׁי‎ Ezek 2:4 (+ חִזְקֵילֵֿב‎), קְשֵׁאלֵֿב‎ 3:7 (+ חִזְקֵימְֿצַח‎); ׳ק‎ alone = stubborn Isa 48:4.
